description: Issue #839: with THREE declarations of `step`, `params.original_span` must point at the FIRST (line 1), and the program must halt at the SECOND (line 4) — the first collision in source order. A rule that recorded "the most recent declaration seen" would name line 4 as the original of a line-7 report; a rule that scanned the whole program symmetrically would have no answer for which one came first at all. The three bodies print different values so the fixture also stays sensitive to any override rule sneaking back in.

diagnostics.message: you already defined step on line 1.
